name: ink-underline
title: Ink Underline
description: A hand-dragged ink stroke that draws itself across in a few stop-motion poses.
useWhen: A hand-dragged ink underline belongs beneath a written headline, URL, or stat.
The scene already runs on the stop-motion clock and the stroke should arrive in the same discrete poses.
avoidWhen: You are painting a highlight behind a word inside a sentence: use marker-highlight.
You want to circle or strike through something.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Width
variables.description: Stroke length in pixels (capped to 90% of the frame).

variables.label: Opening pressure
variables.description: Width at the start of the stroke, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Closing pressure
variables.description: Width at the end of the stroke, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Grain
variables.description: How rough the brush edge is.

variables.label: Delay
variables.description: Frames before the stroke starts (30 fps).

variables.label: Poses to draw
variables.description: Stop-motion poses the stroke takes to draw.

variables.label: Seed
variables.description: Any text; changes the stroke wobble and grain.

variables.label: Frames per pose
variables.description: Stop-motion clock, in frames at 30 fps.
